title: Wynwood Food and Art Walking Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Much more than just a food tour, this excursion dives into the arts, culture, and lifestyle of Miami’s Wynwood neighborhood. Explore Miami’s famous Art District through the flavors of the city as you stop at five local eateries, sampling an international mix of American, Peruvian, Venezuelan, Miami Nouvelle and Mediterranean cuisines along the way.

Get the inside scoop on the Wynwood food scene on this fun outing that replaces lunch or dinner. Meet your local guide and taste a new American culinary approach. Wynwood, full of amazing restaurants, art installations, and eclectic people, is the place to be. 

Go beyond the tourist traps for an insider perspective on Wynwood’s best eats, with a sprinkling of storytelling, history, and arts lessons thrown in along the way by our local experts.
